claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, 3-methyladenine is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent, since its known activity is inhibition of class III PI3K/autophagy at millimolar concentrations and it lacks a potent killing mechanism at low micromolar exposure.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, 3-methyladenine is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent, since its known activity is inhibition of class III PI3K/autophagy at millimolar concentrations and it lacks a potent killing mechanism at low micromolar exposure.
